privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: BudgetFlow is a local-first application. This draft describes the actual data flow and must be completed by the data controller and legally reviewed before production.
sections: The controller is [NON-PRODUCTION: entity name], contact: [NON-PRODUCTION: email], jurisdiction: [NON-PRODUCTION: country].
Account data is needed for authentication, access protection, and synchronization. The legal bases and controller obligations must be confirmed for the target jurisdiction.

We process email, preferences, invitation and administration data, functional tokens/cookies, and operational logs. Financial data is created and stored locally in an encrypted store. The server may store only an opaque encrypted synchronization blob and revision metadata; E2EE does not remove all privacy obligations.
Data is retained as long as needed for its purpose or a legal obligation. Hosting and infrastructure providers: [NON-PRODUCTION: provider list]. We do not use analytics or marketing tracking.

You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, and portability, and complain to the competent authority. Account deletion removes server data but does not automatically remove browser-local data—deliberately use “Clear local data”.
